title: refactor: share the kit test helpers from one module
headline: The seven kit test files import one shared helper module in place of the copies the 1.43.1 split left in each, so a new test in them loads on main when CI proves it fails first. Nothing a project installs changes.
alignment: v1.43.2 is the second pull request of build 18: the shared helpers the 1.43.1 record named as the next step, merged ahead of the rest so that build's new tests load on main.

items.text: `tests/kit-helpers.mjs` holds the helper code the seven kit test files each copied; they import what they use, and every test keeps its exact text.
items.before: Helper code copied in seven files

verification: Every test keeps its exact text, and each file keeps the same number of tests.
Each removed helper had an identical copy in the shared module (checked one for one by the triage review).
The rule map is written fresh for the new module.

decisions.decision: Its own pull request, ahead of build 18
decisions.why: CI proves a new test fails first by running it on main, so the module those tests import must be on main first.

decisions.decision: The budget tests keep their own id counter
decisions.why: An imported counter cannot be bumped, and starting it far from the shared one means no id repeats.
The rule map changes, and CI holds any change outside the install-safe paths to a version and a build record; nothing installed changes.

upgrading: Nothing to do: install copies none of these files. The workbench install can wait for 1.44.0.
